items.title: Barista (NSW casual pool)
items.notes: Pay $34.12/h incl. casual loading, 'above award' (read on Compass job 678361). Sites: Mascot, North Sydney, Randwick, Sydney CBD; Randwick site not named. Barista qualification mandatory; police check, WWCC and RSA held or willing to get. Found on CareerOne (posted ~15 Oct); match to job 678361 is ⚠️ inferred. Distance and transit are ⚠️ estimates.

items.title: Maths Tutor (Casual)
items.notes: Pay $30 to $40/h: range starts below floor, top end above. Ad lists 'Part-time, Casual, Freelance, Contract', so it may be contractor work (check super and loading). Needs 80%+ in high-school maths. Posted 13 Oct 2026. Distance ⚠️ estimate (depends on students matched); transit unknown.

items.title: Administrative Assistant (casual)
items.notes: UNSW job 543395, read on Jobs@UNSW page. Advertised 12 Oct 2026, closes 22 Mar 2027 (looks like a casual pool). Needs prior admin experience and MS Office. Pay not in ad (UNSW casual rates set by its enterprise agreement). Pre-employment checks apply. Distance and transit are ⚠️ estimates.

items.title: Social Media Student Content Assistant, Nura Gili (casual)
items.notes: UNSW job 542263 (Level 2), read on Jobs@UNSW page. Advertised 1 Oct, closes 31 Dec 2026. Application needs a 15-second Instagram Reel filmed on campus. Video and social content for Nura Gili. Pay not in ad. Distance and transit are ⚠️ estimates.

items.title: Jobs on Campus talent pool (casual on-campus roles)
items.notes: Priority access to paid casual campus jobs. Pilot, rolling assessment, job page says closes 31 Dec 2026. Before applying: 1 career workshop or Employability program, 2 online modules, SMART Resume score 70+. Unsuccessful applicants cannot reapply, so apply once, well prepared. Distance and transit are ⚠️ estimates.

items.title: Casual Audio-Visual Production Roles
items.notes: UNSW job 505076, read on Jobs@UNSW page. Evergreen ad since 17 Sep 2024, no closing date. Needs 2+ years AV industry experience (live sound, vision, lighting, streaming): low fit unless you have that. Pay not in ad. Distance and transit are ⚠️ estimates.
